title.narrative: Leveraging private provision of primary and specialised healthcare in Ukraine

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to introduce new models of primary and specialised health services at the local level by engaging private providers in the public funding scheme under the National Health Service of Ukraine. These new models of health care will respond to the population's health needs significantly affected by the ongoing war. The engagement of private providers will allow for increased competition, higher quality of services, and better efficiency for health services.The project has a positive impact on:SDG 8: inclusive and sustainable economic growth: support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation.

The results of this project contribute with a new business model that addresses current needs of primary healthcare in Ukraine, namely: decentralized and diversified provision of services, availability and accessible to population affected by the war (internal displaced people in particular women, children), war veterans with disabilities, adults with chronic diseases. Key results of this project are:
A BASELINE STUDY that provides a detailed assessment of the conditions of the provision of services of the Ukrainian healthcare system; including an analysis of current legislation and ongoing reforms, mapping of stakeholders and opportunities for partnerships for the changes in the current health system.
PROPOSAL OF THE SERVICE DELIVERY MODEL for primary healthcare providers tailormade to the characteristics, challenges and ambitions of improvement of the existing primary health care system. This new model identifies engagement of private providers will allow for increased competition, higher quality of services, and better efficiency for health services at community level. - The scope: PHC+ practices need to become a community-based health centre for small and medium scale communities. - The scale: PHC+ practices have a medium/large group format with more than 10 physician to ensure minimum and diversified services. - The content: defining the types of medical services that have to be included to enhance existing primary health care and the profile of the specialized personnel per practice. - The approach: integrated health project management to guarantee an efficient function of medical practice in small and medium communities. It includes the model of cooperation between different medical specialists at different levels of care.
